abstract: The Australian Carbon Credit Unit (ACCU) Scheme provides opportunities for farmers to benefit financially from sequestering additional carbon in their soils. The Scheme assesses additionality using a ‘newness’ test; if one of a list of eligible farming practices was not used by a farmer in a 5‐year baseline period, its use within the project is considered to be additional. However, this approach is unable to detect non‐additionality in cases where farmer adoption of the eligible farming practice is increasing in the absence of carbon credits. This analysis uses parameters from the actual scheme, combined with soil carbon sequestration rates informed by scientific research, and calculates net financial benefits to farmers from participation in the soil carbon method of the ACCU Scheme. In most scenarios modelled in this study, the net benefits to farmers from participating in the soil carbon scheme are small relative to other costs and revenues from farming (assuming that a recognised existing design problem with the scheme that is causing over‐crediting is corrected). As a result, the area of additional projects is relatively small and can easily be outweighed by non‐additional projects. Therefore, the expenditure on ACCUs required to achieve a tonne of genuine CO 2 ‐e mitigation can be extremely high: up to 80 times higher than the cost of an ACCU in one of the scenarios explored. The prospects of developing a system that accurately assesses the additionality of soil carbon projects seem remote.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚碳信用单位（ACCU）计划为农民提供了通过在其土壤中额外封存碳而获得经济收益的机会。该计划采用“新颖性”测试来评估额外性；如果农民在5年基线期内未使用清单中的任一合格农业实践，则在项目中使用该实践被视为额外。然而，这种方法无法在农民在无碳信用激励下采用合格农业实践呈增长趋势的情况下，检测出非额外性。本分析利用实际计划参数，结合科学研究提供的土壤碳封存速率，计算了农民参与ACCU计划土壤碳方法所获得的净经济收益。在本研究模拟的大多数情景中，农民参与土壤碳计划的净收益相对于农业其他成本和收入而言较小（假设该计划中一个公认的导致过度信用发放的现有设计问题得到修正）。因此，额外项目的面积相对较小，且容易被非额外项目所抵消。因此，为实现一吨真实的二氧化碳当量减排所需的ACCU支出可能极高：在所探讨的某一情景中，这一成本可高达一个ACCU价格的80倍。开发一个能准确评估土壤碳项目额外性的系统的前景似乎渺茫。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Soil Carbon Sequestration Policy in Australia: The Additionality Dilemma
title_zh: 澳大利亚土壤碳封存政策：额外性困境

abstract: We develop a dynamic framework to detect the occurrence of permanent and transitory breaks in the illiquidity process. We propose various tests that can be applied separately to individual events and can be aggregated across different events over time for a given firm or across different firms. We use this methodology to study the impact of forward and reverse stock splits on the illiquidity dynamics of the S&P 500, S&P 400 and S&P 600 index stock constituents. Our empirical results show that stock splits have a positive and significant effect on the permanent component of the illiquidity process while a majority of the stocks engaging in reverse splits experience an improvement in liquidity conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个动态框架，用以识别非流动性过程中永久性与暂时性断裂的发生。我们提出了多种检验方法，既可单独应用于特定事件，也可跨时间对同一企业或跨不同企业进行汇总分析。运用此方法论，我们研究了正向与反向股票拆分对标准普尔500、标准普尔400及标准普尔600指数成分股非流动性动态的影响。实证结果显示，股票拆分对非流动性过程的永久性成分具有正向且显著的影响，而大多数进行反向拆分的股票则经历了流动性状况的改善。
title: The Permanent and Temporary Effects of Stock Splits on Liquidity in a Dynamic Semiparametric Model
title_zh: 股票拆分对流动性的永久与暂时效应：基于动态半参数模型的分析

abstract: We use a sharp regression discontinuity design (RDD) to show that victories by women candidates in close House, Senate, and gubernatorial elections lead to an increase in female directors in firms located in the candidates’ districts. The causal effect is higher when the media coverage of the woman candidate is higher, when voter turnout is high, and when firms have more local directors and local institutional investors. The heterogeneous regression discontinuity (RD) effects suggest that electoral wins may influence local gender norms and firms’ board diversity through multiple channels, including conveying majority views on gender-related social norms, increasing exposure to exemplar women, and facilitating learning about women’s different but effective leadership styles. The evidence suggests a potential spillover effect from women’s political leadership to the corporate world.
abstract_zh: 我们采用精确断点回归设计（RDD）证明，在竞争激烈的众议院、参议院及州长选举中，女性候选人的胜利会导致其所在选区企业女性董事数量的增加。当媒体对女性候选人的报道增多、选民投票率高，以及企业拥有更多本地董事和本地机构投资者时，这一因果效应更为显著。异质性断点回归（RD）效应表明，选举胜利可能通过多种渠道影响当地性别规范及企业董事会多样性，包括传达关于性别相关社会规范的大多数观点、增加对榜样女性的接触，以及促进对女性不同但有效领导风格的学习。证据表明，女性政治领导力可能向企业界产生溢出效应。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Women in Politics: The Effect on Board Diversity
title_zh: 女性参政：对董事会多元化的影响

abstract: The Covid pandemic dramatically altered patterns of daily life, particularly through widespread declines in mobility due to lockdowns and social distancing measures. While the economic and epidemiological effects of these restrictions have been widely studied, their broader health implications remain underexplored. This paper investigates the relationship between mobility decline during the Covid pandemic and hypertension outcomes in India. Leveraging district-level variation in mobility from Google Community Mobility Reports and health data from the 2019–2021 Indian Demographic and Health Survey (DHS), we find that a 1 percentage point reduction in mobility over the 30 days prior to interview is associated with a 0.3 percentage point decrease in the likelihood of having normal blood pressure. The effect is driven by increases in pre-hypertensive and mildly elevated blood pressure, with no significant changes in more severe hypertension. We examine potential mechanisms—healthcare access, stress (proxied by alcohol use), and reduced physical activity—and find limited explanatory power for the former two. These findings suggest that reduced physical mobility likely played a key role in worsening cardiovascular risk profiles. The results underscore the importance of integrating chronic disease considerations into the design of mobility-restricting public health interventions.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情深刻改变了日常生活模式，尤其通过封锁和社交距离措施导致人口流动性普遍下降。尽管这些限制措施的经济和流行病学影响已被广泛研究，但其对健康的更广泛影响仍待深入探讨。本文研究了新冠疫情期间印度人口流动性下降与高血压结果之间的关联。利用谷歌社区流动性报告中的地区级流动性差异数据，以及2019-2021年印度人口与健康调查（DHS）的健康数据，我们发现：受访前30天内流动性每降低1个百分点，血压正常的概率下降0.3个百分点。该效应主要由高血压前期和轻度血压升高病例增加驱动，而重度高血压未见显著变化。我们检验了潜在机制——医疗可及性、压力（以饮酒为代理变量）和体力活动减少——发现前两者的解释力有限。这些结果表明，体力活动减少可能在恶化心血管风险特征中发挥了关键作用。研究结果强调，在设计限制流动性的公共卫生干预措施时，必须将慢性病防控纳入考量。
title: Public Health Trade-Offs During a Pandemic: Mobility Decline and Hypertension Risk in Indialoven
title_zh: 疫情期间的公共卫生权衡：印度流动性下降与高血压风险

abstract: This paper examines the effect of corporate tax avoidance (CTA) on U.S. firm-level sales and its aggregate implications. In theory, CTA gives a competitive edge to avoiding firms, which affects the distribution of sales in the economy. In practice, we find a causal impact of CTA on firm-level sales using a broad set of measures of tax avoidance and different identification strategies. Combining microestimates and the model, we assess how changes in CTA over the past two decades have shaped the distribution of sales across U.S. industries. Although the effects vary by sector, rising CTA among large firms has reinforced their dominant positions, contributing to increased concentration, in several key industries. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05773 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Corporate Tax Avoidance and Sales: Microevidence and Aggregate Implications
